# Deck

## What the cards share

Every card is a Titan Warrior hitting with physical damage: Blood Hunt lunges at a bleeding enemy and consumes its Blood Loss for a burst, or Rolling Slam crushes a pack. Herald of Blood pops the bleeding dead.

## How they differ

Five of seven lead with Blood Hunt and two with Rolling Slam; they differ in the defence and the weapon.

## Round 1

- r1-a-1 "Blood Hunt bleed burst" | one lunge spends the bleed you built for a big hit, so rares melt in two presses
- r1-a-2 "Rolling Slam aftershocks" | Rolling Slam with aftershocks hits a pack twice for one press
- r1-b-1 "Blood Hunt on a two-hander" | a two-handed spear's bigger hit makes every lunge count
- r1-b-2 "Blood Hunt armour stacker" | stacked armour shrugs off the hits that kill most melee builds, and Blood Hunt still bursts | under-played (judgment: an armour-stacking shape, rarely paired with a spear lunge)
- r1-b-3 "Blood Hunt with a bleed unique" | a unique that adds bleed makes the burst bigger from the first hit
- r1-c-1 "Rolling Slam block tank" | a shield and block keep you standing while the slam does the work | under-played (judgment: a block shape few slam builds take)
- r1-c-2 "Blood Hunt with Titan slam notables" | Titan's slam notables make every hit heavier, so the lunge and the slam both grow

## Not dealt

- r1-a-3 "Blood Hunt crit lunge" | no lookup confirms "critical hits inflict Blood Loss"
- r1-c-3 "Blood Hunt rage cycling" | the round was full, and the deck holds the same loop already
